name: awesome-go-linters
desc: A curated list of awesome Go linters. More than 60 linters and tools!

resources.name: GolangCI
resources.desc: Open Source SaaS service for running linters on Github pull requests. Free for Open Source.

resources.name: Golint online
resources.desc: Lints online Go source files on GitHub, Bitbucket and Google Project Hosting using the golint package.

resources.name: GopherCI
resources.desc: GopherCI helps you maintain high-quality Go projects, by checking each GitHub Pull Request, for backward incompatible changes, and a suite of other tests.

resources.name: Go Report Card
resources.desc: Go repo report card.

resources.name: CodeClimate
resources.desc: The open and extensible static analysis platform.

resources.name: CodeFactor
resources.desc: Automated Code Analysis for repos on GitHub or BitBucket.

resources.name: HoundCI
resources.desc: Code review tool for GitHub pull requests

resources.name: QuantifiedCode
resources.desc: Automated code review & repair

resources.name: Scrutinizer
resources.desc: A proprietery code quality checker that can be integrated with GitHub

resources.name: SideCI
resources.desc: An automated code reviewing tool. Improving developers' productivity.

resources.name: dedupimport
resources.desc: Fix duplicate imports that have the same import path but different import names.

resources.name: gofmt
resources.desc: Gofmt formats Go programs. Must have for every project. Don't forget to use -s flag.

resources.name: gofumpt
resources.desc: The tool is a modified fork of gofmt, enforcing a stricter format than gofmt, while being backwards compatible.

resources.name: goimports
resources.desc: Goimports does everything that gofmt does. Additionally it checks unused imports.

resources.name: unindent
resources.desc: Report code that is unnecessarily indented

resources.name: abcgo
resources.desc: ABC metrics for Go source code.

resources.name: depth
resources.desc: Count the maxdepth of go functions. It's helpful to see if a function needs to be splitted into several smaller functions, for readability purpose.

resources.name: funlen
resources.desc: linter that checks for long functions. It can check both the number of lines and the number of statements.

resources.name: gocyclo
resources.desc: Computes and checks the cyclomatic complexity of functions.

resources.name: nakedret
resources.desc: nakedret is a Go static analysis tool to find naked returns in functions greater than a specified function length.

resources.name: splint
resources.desc: It finds any functions that are too long or have too many parameters or results.

resources.name: dogsled
resources.desc: Finds assignments/declarations with too many blank identifiers.

resources.name: dupl
resources.desc: Tool for code clone detection.

resources.name: go-checkstyle
resources.desc: checkstyle is a style check tool like java checkstyle. This tool inspired by java checkstyle, golint. The style refered to some points in Go Code Review Comments.

resources.name: go-cleanarch
resources.desc: go-cleanarch was created to validate Clean Architecture rules, like a The Dependency Rule and interaction between packages in your Go projects.

resources.name: go-consistent
resources.desc: source code analyzer that helps you to make your Go programs more consistent.

resources.name: go-namecheck
resources.desc: source code analyzer that helps you to maintain variable/field naming conventions inside your project.

resources.name: go-printf-func-name
resources.desc: checks that printf-like functions are named with f at the end.

resources.name: go-ruleguard
resources.desc: Define and run pattern-based custom linting rules.

resources.name: gochecknoinits
resources.desc: Find init functions, to reduce side effects in code.

resources.name: gochecknoglobals
resources.desc: Find global vars, to reduce side effects in code.

resources.name: goconst
resources.desc: Find in Go repeated strings that could be replaced by a constant.

resources.name: GoLint
resources.desc: Golint is a linter for Go source code.

resources.name: gosimple
resources.desc: gosimple is a linter for Go source code that specialises on simplifying code.

resources.name: impi
resources.desc: Verify imports grouping and ordering.

resources.name: interfacer
resources.desc: Linter that suggests narrower interface types.

resources.name: lll
resources.desc: Line length linter, used to enforce line length in files.

resources.name: misspell
resources.desc: Finds commonly misspelled English words

resources.name: nofuncflags
resources.desc: disallow boolean params to functions (flags).

resources.name: predeclared
resources.desc: Find code that shadows Go's built-in identifiers (e.g., append, copy, int).

resources.name: revive
resources.desc: ~6x faster, stricter, configurable, extensible, and beautiful drop-in replacement for golint

resources.name: unconvert
resources.desc: Remove unnecessary type conversions from Go source.

resources.name: usedexports
resources.desc: Find in Go exported variables that could be unexported.

resources.name: whitespace
resources.desc: Checks for unnecessary newlines at the start and end of functions

resources.name: apicompat
resources.desc: Checks recent changes to a Go project for backwards incompatible changes.

resources.name: badtime
resources.desc: Badtime is a Golang linter that detects inappropriate usage of the time.Time struct.

resources.name: bodyclose
resources.desc: checks whether HTTP response body is closed and a re-use of TCP connection is not blocked

resources.name: durcheck
resources.desc: durcheck is a very simple linter which detects potential bugs with time.Duration in a Go package.

resources.name: enumcase
resources.desc: enumcase checks every switch statement handles all const values of the type.

resources.name: enumlinter
resources.desc: Enum linter for enumerated types in Go.

resources.name: errcheck
resources.desc: Errcheck is a program for checking for unchecked errors in Go programs.

resources.name: gas
resources.desc: Inspects source code for security problems by scanning the Go AST.

resources.name: go vet
resources.desc: Vet examines Go source code and reports suspicious constructs, such as Printf calls whose arguments do not align with the format string. Can check shadowing of variables, but must be enabled explicitly.

resources.name: gosumcheck
resources.desc: Checks all possible cases of type-switch are handled.

resources.name: go-sumtype
resources.desc: Checks all possible cases of type-switch are handled.

resources.name: mulint
resources.desc: Go lint which detects recursive locks, which may lead to dead locks.

resources.name: safesql
resources.desc: Static analysis tool for Golang that protects against SQL injections.

resources.name: scopelint
resources.desc: scopelint checks for unpinned variables in go programs.

resources.name: sqlrows
resources.desc: checks whether Close on sql.Rows is called.

resources.name: staticcheck
resources.desc: staticcheck is go vet on steroids, applying a ton of static analysis checks you might be used to from tools like ReSharper for C#.

resources.name: deadcode
resources.desc: Finds unused code.

resources.name: ineffassign
resources.desc: Detect when assignments to existing variables are not used.

resources.name: structcheck
resources.desc: Find unused global variables and constants.

resources.name: unparam
resources.desc: Report unused function parameters.

resources.name: unused
resources.desc: unused checks Go code for unused constants, variables, functions and types.

resources.name: varcheck
resources.desc: Find unused global variables and constants.

resources.name: aligncheck
resources.desc: Warn about un-optimally aligned structures.

resources.name: Copyfighter
resources.desc: Statically analyzes Go code and reports functions that are passing large structs by value.

resources.name: maligned
resources.desc: Tool to detect Go structs that would take less memory if their fields were sorted.

resources.name: prealloc
resources.desc: Find slice declarations that could potentially be preallocated.

resources.name: rangerdanger
resources.desc: Tool to detect range statements iterating over addressable arrays

resources.name: flen
resources.desc: Get info on length of functions in a Go package.

resources.name: GoReporter
resources.desc: A Golang tool that does static analysis, unit testing, code review and generate code quality report.

resources.name: golinters
resources.desc: golinters generates HTML reports about Go linters.

resources.name: go-outdated
resources.desc: Console application that displays outdated packages.

resources.name: go-template-lint
resources.desc: go-template-lint is a linter for Go text/template (and html/template) template files.

resources.name: godox
resources.desc: Find all TODO/FIXME comments.

resources.name: lingo
resources.desc: Set of specific checks.

resources.name: megacheck
resources.desc: megacheck runs staticcheck, gosimple and unused at once. Because it is able to reuse work, it will be faster than running each tool separately.

resources.name: go-critic
resources.desc: source code linter that brings checks that are currently not implemented in other linters.

resources.name: tarp
resources.desc: tarp finds functions and methods without direct unit tests in Go source code.

resources.name: go-mnd
resources.desc: Magic number detector for Go.

resources.name: gocheckit
resources.desc: A Go tool to help identify Deprecated Go Modules.

resources.name: golangci-lint
resources.desc: Linters Runner for Go. 5x faster than gometalinter. Nice colored output. Can report only new issues. Fewer false-positives. Yaml/toml config.

resources.name: gometalinter
resources.desc: Metalinter is a tool to automatically apply all static analysis tool and report their output in normalized form.

resources.name: lint
resources.desc: Run linters as part of go test.

resources.name: revgrep
resources.desc: Filters output from static analysis tools, showing only recently changed lines of code

resources.name: reviewdog
resources.desc: "reviewdog" provides a way to post review comments to code hosting service, such as GitHub, automatically by integrating with any linter tools with ease.

resources.name: zb
resources.desc: speedup linting by caching gometalinter result.

resources.name: golintui
resources.desc: A simple terminal UI for Go linters.
